text:
sanjay: quick follow-up from the token rfc — we need a clear decision on org-level API keys vs project-scoped service tokens before private rollout. main questions: migration path, rate-limit mapping, and audit/impersonation story.

maya: +1. current problem: some infra teams use org keys for service-to-service; that bypasses project RBAC and audit. we should prefer project-scoped tokens but need incremental migration.

chris: propose model: keep org API keys for interactive/admin flows only. introduce 'svc tokens' formatted `svc_<short>` with claims `scope:project:<id>` or `scope:org:all`. all runtime auth checks look up token->actor->principal. default rate limits map to token scope (project quota) unless token has org-scoped override.

laura: how to handle existing org keys used by customers? can't break.

sanjay: plan: accept org keys as legacy tokens with `legacy:true` claim, restrict for management endpoints only, and require customers to mint project tokens via token-broker for traffic. docs + migration script to scan usage and surface top callers.

maya: rotation: make project tokens short-lived (12h) and recommend long-lived "installation keys" that mint ephemeral tokens with constrained scopes. that'll solve key rotation + least privilege.

chris: example header we expect: `Authorization: Bearer svc_abcd1234` and broker endpoint: `POST /v1/tokens/mint { "subject": "service-foo", "scope": "project:123", "ttl": 3600 }` returns ephemeral token.

laura: logging: need token->project mapping in logs and trace IDs for request chaining. add `x-actor-id` header in internal calls. Also ensure KMS-backed signing of tokens for offline verification.

auth-bot: note: deployment gate — new token verifier landed in canary, will reject unknown token formats unless `--allow-legacy` enabled.

sanjay: ops question: rate limiting — do we map to project capacity or keep org-level buckets? I prefer project buckets with optional org aggregation for billing.

maya: agree. project buckets for SLOs, org aggregation for billing/alerts. when token is org-scoped, fall back to org bucket.

chris: SDK changes: add helper `client.mintServiceToken(projectId, scopes)` and default header injection. Need to bump major.

laura: timelines? we need this for private deploy in 3 weeks. propose ph1: broker + verifier + legacy-flag; ph2: rotation UX + SDK + migration tool; ph3: enforce project-only by default.

sanjay: ok cool. I'll write short RFC addendum with decision points and action owners: chris->verifier + rate-limit mapping, maya->broker + rotation UX, laura->migration and logging, ops-bot->canary prerequisites. will post draft by EOD.

ops-bot: reminder: canary windows this week 02:00-04:00 UTC, schedule with eng-oncall.

maya: thanks, will sync with security review.

chris: :thumbsup:
